description: Use when the user asks what will decide a dispute, what to watch, or the next dated test. Returns the dated tests that will settle each story, from today forward: date and precision, status, the event, the resolver (which series, release or earnings print decides it) and the story, each with its URL.

include_past.description: Also list tests dated before today.

include_signal.description: Also list the tests that have no date and resolve on a signal.

part.description: Only the tests of one part.

name: deepstack_docket
title: The Docket
